body.statement: Every probability law on a product of standard Borel spaces admits a regular conditional probability kernel for either coordinate given the other, and integrating that kernel against the marginal law reconstructs the joint law.

source.verbatim_statement: Let ξ, η be random elements in S, T, where T is Borel. Then L(ξ, η) = L(ξ) ⊗ μ for a* > x

attestation.note: Verified against the publicly readable transcription of Kallenberg (2021), Foundations of Modern Probability, 3rd ed., pp. 168–169, Theorem 8.5; Springer source-of-record DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-61871-1. Because both coordinates in this node are standard Borel, swapping ξ and η supplies the either-coordinate formulation.
